name: audio_program_mutate
title: Change Program audio
description: One Program-audio change per call: set, pin_set, treatment_set, or revert. This controls source audio only; it does not add, mix, lower, or duck background music, which music_cue_mutate controls. set chooses occurrence-relative Program audio without changing picture — mode accepts replace, silence, clear, or reset; Replace requires an Episode camera_group_key plus the exact footage-session revision from episode_read, and BitterClip derives every recording/source slice from synchronized evidence (the call carries no source coordinates; it addresses stable occurrence IDs and source-time ranges from episode_read, not transcript word times); reset atomically clears the Program pin and every explicit interval policy, omitting occurrence_id and occurrence_source_range. pin_set chooses one stable synchronized camera group as the preferred Program-audio source wherever it has usable coverage, without changing picture, chronology, or the listening reference; auto clears it. The settled fallback is explicit interval Replace or silence, then the pin where covered, then the Program occurrence's own recording, then true silence. treatment_set chooses Speech (a versioned, bounded gain/ramp plan tied to the exact raw audio-authority digest; when audio authority later changes the saved plan reads stale and playback falls back truthfully to Raw) or Raw for an explicit bypass. Speech requires measured short-term loudness from ordinary ingest of a supported new recording. If processing is pending, the result returns a recording-status continuation; terminal unavailable, silence, or insufficient-measurement results retain Raw, and a retry does not regenerate missing measurements. Existing recordings are not backfilled. Speech leveling is separate from final Export mastering. revert applies the server-owned inverse recorded by one Program-audio receipt as a new revision-checked forward edit, failing closed if the prior audio state can no longer be restored exactly.

episode_id.description: Editable Episode public ID that scopes this change.

expected_revision.description: Current Episode revision returned by episode_read.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-stable key for an exact retry.

action.description: One Program-audio action, in the canonical field names of its matching action shape.

occurrence_id.description: Stable occ_... Program occurrence identity. Absent only for reset.

occurrence_source_range.description: Half-open source-time range inside the occurrence. Absent only for reset.

mode.description: replace uses synchronized camera-group audio, silence is deliberate silence, clear removes policy in one occurrence range, and reset clears the whole Program audio graph.

camera_group_key.description: Required for Replace: stable camgrp_... identity from the Episode camera roster.

expected_capture_session_revision.description: Required for Replace: exact footage-session evidence revision returned by episode_read.

camera_group_key.description: Stable camgrp_... identity from the Episode camera roster, or auto to clear the explicit pin.

expected_capture_session_revision.description: Required when pinning: exact footage-session evidence revision returned by episode_read. Absent only when clearing with auto.

mode.description: Speech applies the saved speech-leveling plan; Raw bypasses it.

receipt_id.description: Program-audio operation receipt returned by a prior audio_program_mutate action.

revision.description: Revision committed by this audio operation.

current_revision.description: Current durable Episode head, which may be newer on an exact retry.

audio_program_digest.description: Resolved Program-audio digest committed by this operation.

audio_program.description: Canonical Program-audio intervals shared by immediate playback and render. Null only when changed footage evidence makes the current audio policy fail closed.

audio_program_error.description: Typed fail-closed projection when the current audio policy needs review.

op.description: The revert call is this op with action { type: revert, receipt_id }.

inverse.description: Present only when this write changed Program audio: the revert is audio_program_mutate with action { type: revert, receipt_id }.

digests.description: Program digests before and after this write, and now. Read continuations pin the digest; boundary evidence does not depend on it.

checks.description: The currentness checks this write moved: the Composition revision and the Program digest. Boundary evidence depends on neither; the next edit re-verifies each token at its point.

tool_outcome.description: Receipt-derived consequence of this Program-audio write. The target names the edited Episode or Clip; unchanged means the write settled with nothing to change.
